blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Multi-frame video frame interpolation (VFI) aims to reconstruct dense video from sparse keyframes, requiring accurate intermediate motion and faithful appearance. As temporal gaps grow, flow-based methods can retain observed textures but misplace them under ambiguous motion, whereas iterative latent-diffusion models can synthesize plausible content but incur substantial sampling costs and may alter details during reconstruction with a variational autoencoder (VAE). We present RePix-VFI, named for Re-rendering observed Pixels, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A pretrained video diffusion model refines a flow-rendered draft of the whole window in a single forward pass. For each target frame, our generative readback matches its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction using an optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB pixels outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance. Experiments on benchmark datasets demonstrate significant improvements in reconstruction and perceptual quality. On SNU-FILM at $\times$8 and $\times$16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48dB in PSNR, respectively. It also runs 32--42$\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video frame interpolation (VFI) reconstructs the intermediate frames between observed keyframes, increasing the temporal resolution of a video. It is a fundamental low-level vision task, widely used for slow-motion synthesis [ 14 ] , frame-rate up-conversion, and video compression [ 39 ] , but remains challenging because motion and appearance at unobserved times must be inferred from the available frames. Multi-frame VFI goes beyond a single frame pair, reconstructing a dense video window jointly from several sparse keyframes. Accurate reconstruction requires placing content correctly at intermediate times while preserving observed appearance. As the temporal gap grows, large displacements, nonlinear motion, and occlusions make intermediate motion and visibility ambiguous.
blocks.zh: 视频帧内插(VFI)在观测到的键帧之间重建中间帧,提高视频的时间分辨率. 这是一项基本的低水平视觉任务,广泛用于慢动合成[14],帧率向上转换,以及视频压缩[39],但仍然具有挑战性,因为运动和在不观察时段的出现必须从现有的帧中推断出来. 多帧VFI超越了单帧对,从几个稀疏的键框一起重建了密集的视频窗口. 准确的重建需要在中间时间正确放置内容,同时保留观察到的外观. 随着时间间隔的扩大,大规模迁移、非线性运动和隔离使得中间运动和可见度模糊不清。

blocks.en: To reconstruct intermediate frames while retaining observed appearance, flow-based VFI methods estimate intermediate motion and warp observed pixels or features accordingly [ 11 , 23 , 27 , 16 , 8 , 29 ] . As illustrated in Fig. (a), this provides direct access to keyframe textures, but inaccurate correspondences can misplace detail and produce ghosting under large gaps. Moreover, pixel transport alone cannot reconstruct content absent from all observations.
blocks.zh: 为了在保留观测到的外观的同时重建中间帧,基于流线的VFI方法对中间运动和曲速观测到的像素或特征进行相应的估计[11,23,27,16,8,29]. 如图(a)所示,这可直接获取关键框架纹理,但不准确的函文可能会错误地将细节置于大缺口之下,产生幽灵。 此外,光是像素传输无法在所有观测中重建内容。

blocks.en:
Diffusion-based VFI offers complementary information through learned priors for intermediate appearance or motion [ 6 , 15 , 9 ] . These priors can support plausible predictions when motion is ambiguous or observations are incomplete. Video diffusion models extend these priors to multi-frame VFI, jointly predicting a whole window from multiple keyframes [ 25 ] .
However, as shown in Fig. (b), iterative latent-diffusion models incur substantial sampling costs through repeated network evaluations, and reconstructing frames with a variational autoencoder (VAE) can alter details already available in the keyframes.
blocks.zh:
基于传播的VFI通过学到的前科提供补充信息,用于中间外观或运动[6,15,9]. 这些前科可以支持在运动模棱两可或观察不完整时的可信预测. 视频传播模型将这些前科扩展至多帧VFI,共同从多个键框预测整个窗口[25].
然而,如图(b)所示,迭代式潜在扩散模型通过重复的网络评价而产生大量取样费用,用变异自编码器(VAE)重建框架可以改变键框中已有的细节。

blocks.en:
Prior methods use interpolated estimates to refine motion or match input textures, or derive continuous trajectories from generated latent anchors [ 24 , 40 , 21 ] .
We instead use the RGB predictions from one-step video generation as references for matching the observed keyframes at each target time. This separates the reference used to estimate correspondences from the observed RGB transported by the renderer. Our controlled comparison shows that a generated prediction can provide a better rendering reference even when its RGB PSNR is lower than that of the flow-rendered draft.
blocks.zh:
先前的方法使用内插估计来精炼运动或匹配输入纹理,或从产生的潜锚中得出连续的轨迹[24,40,21].
相反,我们使用单步视频生成的RGB预测作为参照,用于在每个目标时间匹配观察到的关键框架。 这把用于估计对应物的参考物与渲染器所运输的观测到的RGB分开. 我们的控制比较表明,即使其RGB PSNR低于流源代碼,生成的预测也能提供更好的渲染参考.

blocks.en:
Based on this observation, we present RePix-VFI , named for Re -rendering observed Pix els, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes (Fig. (c)).
A flow-based renderer first constructs a dense draft from the observations, providing an initial estimate of intermediate motion and appearance. Starting from the encoded flow-rendered draft, a pretrained video diffusion transformer, fine-tuned as a one-step generator, predicts a latent correction in a single forward pass per window. For each intermediate frame, our generative readback uses a frozen optical-flow estimator to match its two bounding keyframes to the generated prediction.
The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB along a path that bypasses the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with the generated predictions.
blocks.zh:
基于这一观察,我们提出RePix-VFI ,以Re-reforming spected Pix els命名,这是一个多框架的VFI框架,夫妇通过从观测到的键框中进行重建来起草一个步骤的视频传播(图(c))。
一个基于流的渲染器首先从观测中构建一个密集的草稿,提供了中间运动和外观的初步估计. 从编码的流程-传递草稿开始,一个预先训练的视频扩散变压器,作为单步生成器进行微调,预测每个窗口的单个前传中潜在的校正. 对于每个中间帧,我们的基因回溯使用一个冷冻的光流估计器来匹配其两个边框键框与生成的预测.
由此形成的函式指导沿绕过VAE的路径重新将原始键框RGB重置. 轻量级外观聚变头将这些渲染与生成的预测相结合.

blocks.en:
Experiments on SNU-FILM and DAVIS demonstrate the effectiveness of the complete reconstruction framework.
Under the SNU-FILM entire-video protocol at × \times 8 and × \times 16, RePix-VFI achieves the highest PSNR and the lowest LPIPS, FloLPIPS, and tOF among the compared methods, exceeding the best evaluated diffusion-based baseline by 1.71 and 1.48 dB in PSNR, respectively. It also attains the highest PSNR and lowest LPIPS on DAVIS at × \times 4– × \times 16.
Controlled comparisons support the design of generative readback. With the flow estimator and renderer fixed, replacing the flow-rendered draft with the generated prediction as the correspondence reference improves rendering PSNR by 0.45–0.72 dB. The full model also lowers LPIPS relative to Fusion w/o readback at all three factors, and fusion exceeds the better of the re-rendering and the generated prediction by 0.39–1.46 dB. Under the same 49-frame protocol, end-to-end inference is 32–42 × \times faster than LDF-VFI [ 25 ] , the state-of-the-art multi-frame VFI diffusion model.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose RePix-VFI , a multi-frame VFI framework that adapts a pretrained video diffusion transformer for draft-conditioned one-step prediction and reuses its RGB outputs for correspondence estimation and appearance fusion. • We introduce generative readback , which uses the generated predictions at intermediate times as correspondence references for a frozen optical-flow estimator. The resulting correspondences guide re-rendering of original keyframe RGB outside the VAE, followed by lightweight appearance fusion with the generated predictions. • Experiments demonstrate superior reconstruction and perceptual performance, together with improved temporal consistency on SNU-FILM and DAVIS. Controlled ablations examine the roles of generated correspondence references and observation rendering in the complete reconstruction.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: 2.1 Video Frame Interpolation (VFI)
blocks.zh: 2.1 视频框架内插

blocks.en:
Flow-based video frame interpolation. Flow-based VFI methods synthesize intermediate frames by warping or splatting observed pixels and features [ 14 , 23 ] . Recent works improve motion estimation and reconstruction across scales and interpolation times [ 11 , 27 , 45 ] .
GIMM-VFI [ 8 ] uses coordinate-based implicit motion modeling, while BiM-VFI [ 29 ] introduces bidirectional motion descriptors for non-uniform motion.
Some methods match the inputs against intermediate estimates: ABME [ 24 ] refines motion using an interpolated anchor, while VTinker [ 40 ] maps input texture features onto a proxy derived from flow-warped inputs.
blocks.zh:
流线视频帧内插. 流基VFI方法通过曲折或电镀合成中间帧观测到的像素和特征[14,23]. 最近的工作改进了跨尺度和内插时间的运动估计和重建[11、27、45]。
GIMM-VFI [8] 使用坐标基隐含运动模型,而BiM-VFI [29] 为非统一运动引入双向运动描述符.
一些方法将输入与中间估计相匹配:ABME [24] 使用内插锚来精炼运动,而VTinker [40] 将输入纹理特征映射到流序输入产生的代词上.

blocks.en:
Diffusion-based video frame interpolation. Diffusion-based VFI methods model intermediate appearance or motion using generative priors. LDMVFI [ 6 ] performs conditional latent diffusion with a decoder that predicts deformable kernels for sampling, whereas MoMo [ 15 ] and HFD [ 9 ] generate optical flows for subsequent frame synthesis.
For multi-frame VFI, LDF-VFI [ 25 ] jointly synthesizes temporal chunks and connects them autoregressively, and conditions its VAE decoder on features from the observed video.
SpeedVFI [ 7 ] distills multi-frame interpolation into one-step generation from noise latents conditioned on encoded keyframes, and SPEED [ 48 ] generates each intermediate frame with one-step diffusion in pixel space, avoiding latent encoding and decoding.
blocks.zh:
基于传播的视频帧内插. 基于扩散的VFI方法利用基因前缀模拟中间外观或运动. LDMVFI [6] 以可变形内核预测取样的解码器进行有条件的潜在扩散,而MoMo [15]和HFD [9]则产生光学流,用于后续帧合成.
对于多帧VFI,LDF-VFI[25]联合合成时段块并自动连接,并以所观测到的视频的特性为其VAE解码器设置条件.
SpeedVFI [7] 从以编码键框为条件的噪音潜伏物中将多帧插值蒸馏成单步生成,SPEED [48] 生成每个中间帧,在像素空间中以单步扩散,避免潜在编码和解码.

blocks.en:
Generation and observation reuse. Existing methods connect motion estimation, generation, and observation reuse at different stages.
MoG [ 44 ] injects backward-warped input latents and features to constrain generated motion. The training-free SNM-VFI [ 13 ] initializes and iteratively guides video diffusion with flow-derived drafts, then blends flow-based and generated frames with confidence from forward–backward flow consistency. Both use motion estimated from the observations to guide generation.
Other methods exploit generated intermediate representations: MADiff [ 12 ] updates motion hints from intermediate predictions during iterative sampling and uses them for conditional generation and input-feature alignment within its decoder. RDVFI [ 21 ] generates low-resolution sparse latent keyframes with one-step diffusion, estimates continuous pixel trajectories, and synthesizes target frames from warped inputs and generated latent features.
blocks.zh:
生成与观测再利用. 现有方法将不同阶段的运动估计、生成和观测再利用联系起来。
MOG [44] 注入向后扭曲的输入潜伏物和特性来约束生成的运动. 无培训的SNM-VFI[13]以流源草稿初始化并迭代地引导视频传播,然后将流源和生成的帧从前向后流一致性中充满信心地混合起来。 两者都使用观测结果估计的运动来引导生成.
其他方法利用生成的中间表示: MADiff [12] 在迭代采样时更新中间预测中的运动提示,并在其解码器内用于有条件生成和输入特性对齐. RDVFI [21] 产生低分辨率的稀疏潜在密钥框,并有单步扩散,估计连续像素轨迹,并从扭曲输入合成目标框并产生潜在特征.

blocks.en: Distinguished from previous methods, our RePix-VFI couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes. A single generator evaluation refines the encoded flow-rendered draft into a dense RGB prediction. Whereas RDVFI [ 21 ] derives trajectories from sparse latent anchors, our generative readback matches observed keyframes directly to each generated target-time RGB prediction using a frozen optical-flow estimator. These correspondences transport original keyframe RGB outside the VAE, while the generated prediction remains an appearance candidate for fusion.
blocks.zh: 与以前的方法不同,我们的RePix-VFI夫妇起草有条件的单步视频传播,从观察到的键框重建. 单一的生成器评价将编码的流回式草稿精炼成密集的RGB预测. RDVFI [21] 的轨迹来源于稀疏的潜伏锚,而我们的基因回溯匹配 观察到的键框直接与每个生成的目标时间 RGB 预测,使用冷冻的光流估计器. 这些函式将原始键框RGB传送到VAE之外,而生成的预测仍然是聚变的外观候选.

blocks.en: 2.2 One-step Diffusion for Restoration
blocks.zh: 2.2 为恢复而分步扩散

blocks.en: One-step restoration methods adapt pretrained diffusion priors for efficient image and video reconstruction [ 7 , 21 ] . OSEDiff [ 41 ] starts from the encoded degraded image instead of noise and regularizes the output with variational score distillation (VSD). DOVE [ 2 ] adapts a pretrained video diffusion model through latent-space training followed by pixel-space refinement, while SeedVR2 [ 35 ] combines progressive distillation with adversarial post-training. PS-SR [ 38 ] trains a source-initialized base model in latent and pixel space, then supplements lightweight model evaluation with iterative refinement. We adopt latent-to-pixel training for draft-conditioned video generation and connect its completed predictions to correspondence estimation and reconstruction from observed keyframes.
blocks.zh: 单步修复方法为高效的图像和视频重建调整了事先经过训练的传播前科[7,21]. OSEDIF [41] 从编码的退化图像开始而不是噪音,并以变异分数蒸馏(VSD)使输出规范化. DOVE [2]通过潜-空间训练,调整了预先训练的视频传播模式,然后对像素-空间进行精细化,而SeedVR 2 [35]则将渐进蒸馏与对抗性后训练相结合. PS-SR [38]在潜伏和像素空间中培训一个源初始化的基础模型,然后通过迭代完善来补充轻量级模型评价. 我们采用潜在到像素的训练来制作预设的视频,并将其完成的预测与从观测到的关键框架进行通信估计和重建联系起来。

blocks.en: 3 RePix-VFI
blocks.zh: 3 个 RPix-VFI

blocks.en: Fig. 2 illustrates the proposed four-stage pipeline. A flow-rendered draft provides an initial estimate of intermediate motion and appearance. A pretrained video diffusion transformer then refines the draft’s latent representation in a single forward pass per window. The decoded target frames connect generation to observation reconstruction: each prediction serves as both an RGB reference for estimating keyframe-to-target correspondences and an appearance candidate for fusion. The rendering path thus uses generated predictions for matching while drawing its RGB pixels from the observations, outside the VAE. A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance.

blocks.en:
Training data and implementation. We fine-tune Wan2.2-TI2V-5B [ 32 ] on LAVIB [ 30 ] using rank-32 LoRA [ 10 ] and 49-frame, 512 × 512 512\times 512 crops, with keyframe intervals sampled uniformly from 2 to 16 and random temporal phases.
Generator adaptation comprises 5k latent-stage and 30k pixel-stage updates at t b = 0.599 t_{b}=0.599 , while the appearance fusion head is trained for 13.5k updates in total using frozen generator outputs.
Optimization, fusion initialization, and other details are provided in the Appendix .

培训数据和执行。 我们在LAVIB上对Wan2.2-TI2V-5B[32]进行微调,使用排名-32 LORA[10]和49-帧,512×512 512\时的512种作物,按键框间隔从2到16个统一取样,随机时间阶段.
发电机改造包括5千个潜在级和30千个像素级更新,时间为t b = 0.599 t_{b}=0.599,而外观聚变头则使用冷冻发电机输出值对总共13.5千个更新值进行培训。

blocks.en:
Benchmarks and baselines. We evaluate at interpolation factors s ∈ { 4 , 8 , 16 } s\in\{4,8,16\} using the SNU-FILM entire-video protocol [ 3 , 25 ] and DAVIS 2016 [ 26 ] at native 1080p resolutions.
At each factor, every s s -th frame is retained as a keyframe, and the remaining frames are reconstructed.
Table 1 compares our RePix-VFI with 15 VFI baselines using released weights, covering non-diffusion and diffusion-based VFI.
All methods reconstruct the same target frames from the same subsampled videos using their native temporal contexts.

blocks.en:
Metrics. We measure reconstruction fidelity using PSNR and SSIM [ 37 ] , perceptual similarity using

PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS, and FloLPIPS are computed on missing frames, whereas tOF uses all adjacent frame pairs, including observed-frame transitions. The metrics are averaged equally over sequences.

blocks.en: 4.5 Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.5 效率

blocks.en:
RePix-VFI evaluates the video generator once per window, sharing this computation across the target frames. Under the 49-frame, 720p/B200 protocol (Table 5 ), the complete pipeline requires 0.175–0.319 s per synthesized frame, including flow estimation, rendering, and fusion, achieving a 32–42 × \times speedup over the evaluated 16-step LDF-VFI [ 25 ] . This reduction comes with higher peak allocated memory (42.05 vs. 11.91 GiB), while MoMo, EDEN, and SPEED have lower latency.
At × \times 8, enabling readback adds 0.050 s per synthesized frame, resulting in a total latency of 0.186 s/frame. For this factor, Table 3 shows that Full reconstruction (Ours) improves PSNR by 0.27 dB and reduces LPIPS by 0.0037 over Fusion w/o readback on SNU-FILM.

blocks.en: 4.6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.6 限制

blocks.en: Our reconstruction remains sensitive to the accuracy of the generated reference and the estimated correspondences, as errors in either can propagate to the re-rendered observations and persist after fusion. The framework also retains substantial computational and memory requirements: although one-step generation avoids repeated sampling, the video backbone and subsequent reconstruction stages remain costly compared with lightweight VFI methods.
blocks.zh: 我们的重建仍然对生成的参考和估计的通信的准确性十分敏感,因为两者的错误都可以传播到重新提交的观察中,并在聚变后继续存在。 该框架还保留了大量的计算和内存要求:虽然单步生成可以避免重复采样,但与轻量级VFI方法相比,视频主干线和随后的重建阶段仍然昂贵.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We presented RePix-VFI, a multi-frame VFI framework that couples draft-conditioned one-step video diffusion with reconstruction from observed keyframes.
Generative readback matches observed keyframes to generated predictions using a frozen optical-flow estimator, providing correspondences for re-rendering their original RGB pixels.
A lightweight appearance fusion head combines these renderings with generated appearance.
Experiments on SNU-FILM and DAVIS demonstrate improved reconstruction, perceptual quality, and temporal consistency, while controlled ablations further support the use of generated correspondence references. This design allows generated predictions to guide the placement of observed pixels without requiring the generator to reproduce all available appearance details.

我们介绍了RePix-VFI,这是一个多框架的VFI框架,夫妇通过观察到的关键框架进行重建,起草一个步骤的视频传播。
基因回读匹配观测到的键框,以使用冷冻的光流估计器生成预测,提供通信,以重新发送其原始的RGB像素.
轻量级的外观聚变头将这些渲染与生成的外观相结合.
关于SNU-FILM和DAVIS的实验表明,重建、感知质量和时间一致性得到了改进,同时控制线片进一步支持使用生成的函证参考。 这种设计使得生成的预测能够指导可观测到的像素的放置,而不需要生成器复制所有可用的外观细节.

During latent-stage adaptation, the frozen Wan model [ 32 ] provides the reference score; an auxiliary model with separate LoRA adapters is trained with a flow-matching objective on detached generated latents.
A framewise 2D discriminator operating in latent space supplies the adversarial loss. Pixel-stage adaptation uses VGG-LPIPS [ 46 ] .

blocks.en:
Reconstructing fine structures under fast motion remains challenging, as illustrated by the wheel blur at τ = 0.750 \tau=0.750 in Fig. 5 .
In the accompanying DAVIS car-roundabout and car-shadow demo videos, wheels can show less rotation than in GT while the vehicle moves.
A temporal loss focused on moving object parts could help recover such local motion.
A smaller video backbone and reduced-resolution readback could reduce the dominant costs in Table 12 .
blocks.zh:
在快速运动下重建精细结构仍然具有挑战性,如图5中的轮子模糊=0.750\tau=0.750所示。
在配套的DAVIS汽车绕行和车影演示视频中,车轮的旋转率比GT在车辆行驶时要低.
以移动物体部件为重点的时间损失可有助于恢复这种局部运动。
一个较小的视频主干线和降低分辨率的回读可以降低表12中的主要成本。
